row: I8 acceptance corpus (500 recorded runs) and defect 114
what_changed: `build()` now wraps the whole ingest loop in one transaction and `insert_rows()` counts new rows with `total_changes` instead of two `COUNT(*)` sweeps. Same rows, same dump: `commits` fell from 1 000 (one per capsule per build) to 2, and `selects` from 8 008 to 8.
